parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649961. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter activities by assay_id corresponding to CHEMBL4649961. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
